description: The file defines a Flutter widget for a dashboard screen in an attendance tracking application. It includes UI components such as overview summaries, recent attendance list, and quick actions. It interacts with multiple providers (AttendanceProvider, ReportProvider, AuthProvider) to fetch and display dynamic data.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays an overview of today's attendance, summary, recent attendance list, and quick actions.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI of DashboardScreen, including fetching data and building the layout.

classes.name: _SummaryCard
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a card with a header and content, used to display different sections on the dashboard.

classes.name: _CounterPill
classes.description: A small badge-like widget displaying numerical counters for attendance statuses.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: A widget showing the status of attendance (present, absent, etc.) with color coding.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Overrides to initiate data fetching when dependencies change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, assembling the layout and dynamic data components.

methods.name: _countStatus
methods.description: Counts the number of attendance items matching a specific status.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Generates a date string key in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.
